_about: Which industries each Senate committee oversees, as SEC Standard Industrial Classification (SIC) code ranges. A trade is flagged when a senator trades a company in an industry their own committee oversees. This mapping is a judgment call kept deliberately narrow; edit it openly and note changes in the changelog.

SSAS.label: Armed Services
SSAS.industries: Defense: aircraft, missiles, ordnance, defense electronics

SSBK.label: Banking, Housing, and Urban Affairs
SSBK.industries: Banks, lenders, brokers, real estate, investment firms

SSEG.label: Energy and Natural Resources
SSEG.industries: Oil and gas, mining, coal, refining, utilities

SSEV.label: Environment and Public Works
SSEV.industries: Heavy construction, waste and environmental services

SSHR.label: Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions
SSHR.industries: Pharmaceuticals, medical devices, health services, education companies
